```{r setup, include = F}
library(flexdashboard)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F, warning = F)
```



```{r, include = F, cache = T, echo = F}
cost <- read.csv("Total_Cost.csv", header = T, encoding = "UTF-8")

direct_revenue <- read.csv("Direct_Revenue.csv", header = T, encoding = "UTF-8")

attendance <- read.csv("Attendance.csv", header = T, encoding = "UTF-8")
```

Row
-----------------------------------------------------------

### Total Cost

```{r}
total_cost <- sum(cost$Cost..RM.)

if(total_cost %% 1 == 0){
  format_value <- paste0("RM ", formatC(total_cost, format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ","))
} else{
  format_value <- paste0("RM ", formatC(round(total_cost, 2), format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ","))
}

valueBox(value = format_value, icon = "ion-pricetags", caption = "Total Cost", color = "#4a7ba6")
```


### Total Direct Revenue

```{r}
total_direct_revenue <- sum(direct_revenue$Revenue..RM.)

if(total_direct_revenue %% 1 == 0){
  format_value <- paste0("RM ", formatC(total_direct_revenue, format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ","))
} else{
  format_value <- paste0("RM ", formatC(round(total_direct_revenue, 2), format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ","))
}

valueBox(value = format_value, icon = "ion-ios-list", 
         caption = "Total Direct Revenue", color = "#f9e1e0")
```


### Total Indirect Revenue

```{r}
domestic_regions <- c("Sabah", "Sarawak", "Peninsular Malaysia", "Labuan")

domestic_attendance <- attendance[attendance$Origin %in% domestic_regions,]
international_attendance <- attendance[!attendance$Origin %in% domestic_regions,]

avg_domestic_spending_2023 <- 417
avg_international_spending_2024 <- 4086.60

total_domestic <- sum(domestic_attendance$Estimated.Attendance)
total_international <- sum(international_attendance$Estimated.Attendance)

indirect_revenue_domestic <- total_domestic * avg_domestic_spending_2023
indirect_revenue_international <- total_international * avg_international_spending_2024

total_indirect_revenue <- indirect_revenue_domestic + indirect_revenue_international

if(total_indirect_revenue %% 1 == 0){
  format_value <- paste0("RM ", formatC(total_indirect_revenue, format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ","))
} else{
  format_value <- paste0("RM ", formatC(round(total_indirect_revenue, 2), format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ","))
}

valueBox(value = format_value, icon = "ion-android-cart",
         caption = "Total Indirect Revenue", color = "#9799ba")
```

Row
-----------------------------------------------------------

### Total Revenue

```{r}
total_revenue <- total_direct_revenue + total_indirect_revenue

if(total_revenue %% 1 == 0){
  format_value <- paste0("RM ", formatC(total_revenue, format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ","))
} else{
  format_value <- paste0("RM ", formatC(round(total_revenue, 2), format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ","))
}

valueBox(value = format_value, icon = "ion-pie-graph", caption = "Total Revenue", color = "#bc85a3")
```


### Economic Multiplier Effect

```{r}
Economic_Impact_Multiplier <- total_revenue / total_cost

valueBox(value = paste0(round(Economic_Impact_Multiplier, 2), "x"), icon = "ion-stats-bars", caption = "Economic Multiplier Effect", color = "#feadb9")
```


Total Cost{data-icon="ion-pricetags"}
===========================================================

### Table 1

```{r, cache = T, echo = F}
cost_df <- cost

cost_df$Cost..RM. <- formatC(cost_df$Cost..RM., format = "f", digits = 2)

datatable(setNames(cost_df, c("Category", "Cost (RM)")), rownames = F, options = list(dom = 'tr'))
```

### Visualisation

```{r, cache = T, echo = F}
cost <- cost %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = Cost..RM. / sum(Cost..RM.) * 100,
    Label = paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%")
  )

pie1 <- ggplot(cost, aes(x = " ", y = Cost..RM., fill = Category)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Cost Distribution by Category") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

print(pie1)
```


Total Direct Revenue{data-icon="ion-ios-list"}

### Table 2

```{r, cache = T, echo = F}
datatable(setNames(direct_revenue, c("Source", "Revenue (RM)")), rownames = F, options = list(dom = 'tr'))
```

### Visualisation

```{r, cache = T, echo = F}
plot_ly(direct_revenue) %>% 
  add_bars(
    x = ~Source, 
    y = ~Revenue..RM., 
    text = ~paste0("Revenue: RM ", format(Revenue..RM., big.mark = ",")),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    textposition = "none",
    marker = list(color = c("#005f73", "#0a9396", "#94d2bd"))
    ) %>% 
  layout(
    title = "Revenue Distribution",
    xaxis = list(title = "Sources", showgrid = F, showline = F),
    yaxis = list(title = "", showgrid = F, showticklabels = F),
    showlegend = F
  )



# making the bar chart cannot run
method_2 <- function() {# bar1 <- 
  ggplot(data = direct_revenue, aes(x = Source, y = Revenue..RM.)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = c("#005f73", "#0a9396", "#94d2bd")) +
  labs(title = "Revenue Distribution", x = "Sources", y = "Revenue (RM)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),          
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),         
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}

# remove the # at ggplotly if want to use method 2
# ggplotly(bar1, tooltip = c("y", "x"))
  
```

Economic Multiplier Effect{data-icon="ion-stats-bars"}
===========================================================


### Visualisation
```{r, cache = T, echo = F}
Economic_Impact_Multiplier_df <- data.frame(
  Category = c("Total Revenue", "Total Cost"),
  Amount = c(total_revenue, total_cost)
)


Economic_Impact_Multiplier_df <- Economic_Impact_Multiplier_df %>% mutate(
  Fraction = Amount / sum(Amount),
  ymax = cumsum(Fraction),
  ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0),
  LabelPosition = (ymax + ymin) / 2
)


pie2 <- ggplot(data = Economic_Impact_Multiplier_df, aes(ymax = ymax, ymin = ymin, xmax = 2.5, xmin = 1.5, fill = Category)) +
  geom_rect(color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(c(-1, 4)) +
  labs(title = "Total Revenue VS Total Cost", subtitle = paste0("Economic Impact Multiplier = ", round(Economic_Impact_Multiplier, 2), "x")) +
  geom_text(x = 0.3, aes(y = LabelPosition, label = Economic_Impact_Multiplier, color = Category)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Total Revenue" = "#849561", "Total Cost" = "#b78d6a")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Total Revenue" = "#849561", "Total Cost" = "#b78d6a")) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none")

print(pie2)
```


### Limitations
- The average international spending is based on national data and may overestimate actual behaviour in Sabah.
- Average Occupancy Rate (AOR) and Average Room Rate (ARR) were not included in Economic Impact Multiplier due to insufficient guest data.
- The attendance numbers are based on surveys, not ticket scans.
